'''Baas's Wisdom''', named for the legendary Jedi Master [[Bodo Baas]], was an uncommon [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] seldom used in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] construction. The crystal imparted a freezing effect when used during combat, inflicting a minor amount of frostbite. The Baas's Wisdom crystal gave a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blade a notable navy blue [[Color/Legends|color]].

==Behind the scenes==
Baas's Wisdom appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Baas's Wisdom was part of a series of 19 unique lightsaber color crystals created in the context of the [[W:c:swg:Publish 9 Notes for 29 June 04|Publish 9]]'s Jedi system revamp<ref name="SWG:js">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|jedi_spam.stf}}</ref> in [[June]] [[2004]].<ref name="P9">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?page=Recent%20Updates|text=Publish 9 Secrets of the Force}}</ref> However, only one of those crystals — [[Sunrider's Destiny]] — was made available in the game.<ref name="SWG:CEL">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=general|Capture Enemy Leadership|Dathomir}}</ref> Baas's Wisdom and the other crystals were not introduced in the game at that time.<ref name="soe.lithium">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=jedi&message.id=1286265|text=A perfect way to (re)introduce all named color crystals and flawless pearls: Chu-Gon Dar Cube!|archiveurl=https://www.swgemu.com/archive/scrapbookv51/data/20070213155714/index.html|nolive=1}}</ref><ref name="thehonorempire">{{WebCite|url=https://www.thehonorempire.org/web/forums/topic/8045-rare-color-crystal-colors|text=Rare Color Crystal Colors|archivedate=20250801192732}}</ref> Baas's Wisdom was eventually added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Hotfix 21.4|Hotfix 21.4]] on [[October 20]], [[2011]]. Players had a small chance to [[W:c:swg:Rare Loot System|loot]] the crystal from enemies defeated during [[W:c:swg:Hotfix 21.3|raids]].<ref name="21.4">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=69225&month=102011|text=Star Wars Galaxies Hotfix 21.4 -- Thursday, October 20, 2011}}</ref>
